name: @arex95/phalanx
description: Opinionated REST + Auth foundation for Vue 3 admin panels. Typed CRUD services, declarative actions with authorization and confirmation, and in-memory tokens with an HttpOnly refresh cookie.

scripts.build: npm run clean && rollup -c && node scripts/fix-dts-aliases.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release: npm version patch && npm run changelog && git add CHANGELOG.md package.json pnpm-lock.yaml && git commit -m "chore(release): update changelog" && git push && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run changelog && git add CHANGELOG.md package.json pnpm-lock.yaml && git commit -m "chore(release): update changelog" && git push && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run changelog && git add CHANGELOG.md package.json pnpm-lock.yaml && git commit -m "chore(release): update changelog" && git push && npm publish --access public

author: Arturo Rafael Serrano Girón
